name: DON'T LOOK BACK [PRE-ALPHA]
desc:
🌟1.5X XP ALL WEEKEND 🌟

Loot and find scraps by day. Complete objectives. Sell what you find and buy gear and weapons.
When night falls, a new set of threats is chosen. You must avoid them... or fight back.

Survive until dawn.

Use your weapons, tools, and your head, solo or with friends.

Each night is different. How long can you last?

Maps: The Backrooms, Pine Woods, Redwood Road, Wasteland, Area 51, Farmland

🎮 Controls: bottom right of your screen
⚠️ Loud sounds, flashing lights, and jumpscares

[Game is in alpha, so bugs, frequent updates and changes are to be expected]
